/prev-portal/ pins @rocket/cli at 0.10.2 - the last version that can build the site published under
/prev - and every update Dependabot finds there is either impossible (its transitive dependencies
only move when the cli moves) or breaking. Since #2946 gave that build its own manifest and lockfile,
the automatic security updates fire once per cycle, each bundling a vulnerable transitive dependency
with the same 0.10.2 -> 0.21.0 bump (the five PRs #2950-#2954).

The config lists only /prev-portal, so alerting and security updates stay on for the root, the
workspaces and portal/, and no scheduled version updates are enabled
